provenance: Actual medium-size contact sheets assembled from Hays iNaturalist source observations; GitHub Actions run 43082259563 artifact 13883764250 (one-day). Per-photo image licenses checked, with original observer/credit metadata in temporary artifact. No third-party photo bytes committed to GitHub.
limits: These are actual visual examinations of a contact sheet, not full-resolution dissection or authenticated herbarium vouchers.
General growth form and flowering heads alone frequently cannot prove grass species when the Flora requires glume, lemma, awn and ligule details.
Wild-tagged iNaturalist records can show cultivated lawns/crops; confirmed local establishment is separate.
Photos retained temporarily only for noncommercial review; public website reuse requires independent license and attribution checks.

records.visible_evidence: Woody running bamboo thicket, narrow lanceolate leaves and node branching, multiple culms; compatible with Phyllostachys.
records.not_established_by_photos: Basal culm internode crowding/compression characteristic of fishpole bamboo, grooved internodes and branch node details not demonstrated; planting or escaped-colony provenance not established.
records.next_diagnostic_photo_target: Low culm internodes and nodes with scale, stem groove, branching arrangement; check location context for cultivated colony.

records.visible_evidence: Broad-bladed mowed sod/turf habit, compatible with commonly planted St Augustine grass.
records.not_established_by_photos: Turf scenes do not expose stolon joints, keeled compressed sheath, hair-ring ligule, or unique sunken florets on a corky rachis; research-grade wild tag does not establish spontaneous Hays occurrence.
records.next_diagnostic_photo_target: Fertile inflorescence in situ; stolon nodes, compressed sheath, ligule; explicit planting/escape context.

records.visible_evidence: Distinct stiff, terminal wheatlike cereal spikes; some mature awned and some green heads, with full plant bases.
records.not_established_by_photos: Wheat versus other Triticum, Hordeum or cereal cultivar forms cannot be established with certainty at this scale; observations may be crop or seed spill escapes rather than wild populations.
records.next_diagnostic_photo_target: Individual sessile spikelets on zigzag axis, broad glumes, paired auricles, crop/volunteer site context.

records.visible_evidence: Clearly forked Y/V-shaped pair of spike-like racemes with small spikelets; smooth narrow leaves and mowed lawn/field context.
records.not_established_by_photos: Paired racemes strongly support Bahia grass but microscopic broadly ovate glumes and seed size not confirmed; many records from lawns and could be introduced turf.
records.next_diagnostic_photo_target: Spikelet scale plus glume, rhizome and leaf collar; planted pasture/turf versus adventive context.

records.visible_evidence: Bottlebrush-like narrow fuzzy panicles, often green but some tan, and visible radiating bristles, clumped annual-looking plants.
records.not_established_by_photos: Short-burst bristle arrangement and finely rugose fertile lemma are not resolved against Setaria pumila, S. parviflora and other foxtails; many closeup images of head but no spikelet dissections.
records.next_diagnostic_photo_target: Scale bristles/spikelets, mature lemma surface, basal roots and ligule; side-by-side other Hays foxtails.

records.visible_evidence: Some tall, silvery plume-bearing ornamental clumps look consistent with pampas grass; narrow, strap-like leaves in tuft.
records.not_established_by_photos: At least one observation (62141431) shows multiple short cylindrical fountain-grass-like plumes that are NOT clearly the large branched Cortaderia panicle, raising a possible mixed/misidentified iNaturalist set. Cultivated landscaping likely.
records.next_diagnostic_photo_target: Recheck observation 62141431 first; compare Cortaderia broad branched panicle to fountain grass Cenchrus/Pennisetum; flower structure, hairy ligule, planting context.

records.visible_evidence: Well-displayed branched awned inflorescences, broad leaf blades, markedly hairy/papillose sheaths in closeups, and wetland edge habitat; multiple independent observations.
records.not_established_by_photos: Awn and papilla-based sheath hairs strongly favor Walter's barnyardgrass, but the critical lower floret lemma/awn origin, glume size and comparison with E. crus-galli are not fully measured.
records.next_diagnostic_photo_target: MM-scale mature spikelets and papilla-based sheath hair macro, paired comparison with E. crus-galli; check any leaf-collar ligule absence.

records.visible_evidence: Short cylindrical green bristly panicle with densely overlapping awned or pointed spikelets; small tufted grass.
records.not_established_by_photos: Actual glume and lemma awn origins, floret counts and ligule unclear; compact spikelike heads resemble other small pooid grasses.
records.next_diagnostic_photo_target: Spikelet dissection and awned glumes, lemma teeth, ligule, comparison with Koeleria/other annual grasses.

records.visible_evidence: Green grain-bearing inflorescence, coarse grass-like blades and stem closeups visible; a separate full plant photographed in disturbed ground.
records.not_established_by_photos: Several views show unusually narrow/contracted green heads versus typically broad, loose proso millet panicle, which could reflect immaturity or incorrect ID; no ripe grain/spikelet morphology or cultivar origin verified.
records.next_diagnostic_photo_target: Mature broadly branched proso-millet panicle, plump spikelets, papilla-hairy sheath and 1–3 mm ligule; cropping/seed-spill context.

records.visible_evidence: Very narrow cylindrical green flowering heads with short bristles, basal leafy tussocks and flowering culms with hand scale.
records.not_established_by_photos: Bristle length only approximate, maturity and perennial rhizomatous/tufted base uncertain; fertile lemma fine rugosity/wrinkles unresolvable.
records.next_diagnostic_photo_target: Scale 4–15 mm bristles and spikelets, mature finely wrinkled lemma, basal crown with roots; compare S. parviflora and S. viridis.

records.visible_evidence: Narrow erect densely flowered spikes/panicles, tan maturing flowers, green panicle heads, a close sheath/leaf junction and multiple independent field scenes.
records.not_established_by_photos: Second glume wide obovate blunt apex, floret arrangement and distinction from Koeleria or other wedgescales cannot be proven from contact-size images.
records.next_diagnostic_photo_target: Macro of second glume face/apex and lemma, 2–3 florets, membranous ligule 1.5–3 mm, compared with S. interrupta.

records.visible_evidence: Loose branched panicle with small drooping florets over lanceolate leaf blades, some contextual rocky ground photographs.
records.not_established_by_photos: Only three images and no spikelet closeup, lemma/membrane characters or base; no independent confirmation versus related Panicum/Steinchisma.
records.next_diagnostic_photo_target: Full flowering panicle under scale, mature spikelet with glumes/lemmas and ligule; verify older Flora Panicum hians combination.
